question: We plan to refresh a TEST pod from Production and then mask its customer data. What prerequisites apply to the refresh and the subsequent masking, and will the refresh copy feature flags and extra language packs?

result.question: We plan to refresh a TEST pod from Production and then mask its customer data. What prerequisites apply to the refresh and the subsequent masking, and will the refresh copy feature flags and extra language packs?
result.answer:
Before you start, note these restrictions from the cited documentation:
> * The source pod and the target pod to be refreshed should be of the same BusinessApp version and state of all patches and cloudnative must be same [doc-0095]

> * User must take back-up of the Target environment before scheduling a refresh of the environment. [doc-0095]

> We have support for data masking as a post pod action.Data Masking is used for hiding PII data and for masking the fields in DB according to the DM template ingested while creation of the release.This is only applicable on non prod type pods.The Pod to be used for data masking should be with a version at least 11.13.24.10.0-11000 or above. [doc-0092]

Documented guidance:
- Before scheduling a refresh, the user must take a backup of the target environment. [doc-0095]
- The source and target pods must have the same BusinessApp version, patch state, and cloudnative configuration. [doc-0095]
- Feature flags and extra language packs are not carried over during the refresh; the target pod's individual settings are honored. [doc-0095]
- Data masking is only applicable on non-production type pods and requires a version of at least 11.13.24.10.0-11000 or above. [doc-0092]
- Data masking works only for releases where the Data Masking template has already been ingested. [doc-0092]
- Multiple data masking runs are not yet supported as a feature. [doc-0092]

Sources:
- [doc-0095] PipelineHub Preflight - Post Pod Actions - Pod P2T Refresh
- [doc-0092] PipelineHub Preflight - Post Pod Actions - Data Masking

Links, commands, and configurations in this adapted documentation are illustrative.

### Uptake P2T (Refresh) as a post pod action

This feature is now available as a **Pod Add-on**feature. User can now refresh a "**TEST**" type environment from a "**Production**" environment.

All BusinessApp Environments are created of type "**Production"**by default. To create a "TEST" type environment, be sure to use following option in Advanced Parameters. 

**Prerequisites  :**

**Ideally PODs should be symmetrical from service integration perspective; compatible patches; same effective BusinessApp Version, IdentityService/ManagedDatabase/IDM should match;**

* The source pod and the target pod to be refreshed should be of the same BusinessApp version and state of all patches and cloudnative must be same
* User must take back-up of the Target environment before scheduling a refresh of the environment.

This takes around 5 to 7 hrs. 

**EnvironmentService REFRESH - Status One Off Check:**

A refresh button is now enabled to perform one-off status check for REFRESH_POD

Additional information regarding the REFRESH use case:

Ideally PODs should be symmetrical from service integration perspective; compatible patches; same effective BusinessApp Version, IdentityService/ManagedDatabase/IDM should match;

### Uptake P2T (Refresh) as a post pod action

This feature is now available as a Post Pod Action feature. User can now refresh a "**TEST**" type environment from a "**Production**" environment.

All BusinessApp Environments are created of type "**Production"** by default. To create a "TEST" type environment, be sure to use following option in Advanced Parameters.

**Prerequisites :**

**Ideally PODs should be symmetrical from service integration perspective; compatible patches; same effective BusinessApp Version, IdentityService/ManagedDatabase/IDM should match;**

* The source pod and the target pod to be refreshed should be of the same BusinessApp version and state of all patches and cloudnative must be same
* User must take back-up of the Target environment before scheduling a refresh of the environment.

This takes around 5 to 7 hrs.

**EnvironmentService REFRESH - Status One Off Check:**

A refresh button is now enabled to perform one-off status check for REFRESH_POD

retrieved_sources.text:
Additional information regarding the REFRESH use case:

Ideally PODs should be symmetrical from service integration perspective; compatible patches; same effective BusinessApp Version, IdentityService/ManagedDatabase/IDM should match;

* dbChange(add new column before refresh) == will be refreshed from SOURCE
* language pack (add extra lang before refresh) == **not carried over**
* \*toggleAutoSchedule (true/false) == not carried over **: individual pod's settings honored**
* \*featureFlag(add/Remove) == **not carried over : individual pod's settings honored**
* deleteSpService == **not carried over;**
* \*addFreeForm tag == **not carried over: individual pod's settings honored**
* scaleout/resize == not carried over
* runtimediagnostics (from source to target) = **old RuntimeDiagnostics db is deleted and re-Enabled on the TARGET POD**
* patches = same BusinessApp release and Patch bundles
* source deploymenttemplate and target is starter (at same relLabel) = **post Refresh - TARGET will have DeploymentTemplate**

Here are additional Details from EnvironmentService about P2T - EnvironmentService REFRESH (P2T)

* Value and minVersion are optional fields
* Not all feature flags can be added to an existing BusinessApp POD, please confirm with EnvironmentService team if the flag is supported

Support Data Masking as post pod action
---------------------------------------

We have support for data masking as a post pod action.Data Masking is used for hiding PII data and for masking the fields in DB according to the DM template ingested while creation of the release.This is only applicable on non prod type pods.The Pod to be used for data masking should be with a version at least 11.13.24.10.0-11000 or above.

**Note:**

* Data masking will work for the releases for which DM template is already ingested.(Ex:GA,HWM ).

**Feature not yet supported:**

* Multiple data masking runs.

More details on Data Making: <https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-399>

**Data Masking Oneoff Job:**

For cases where the data masking is timed out ,there will be a replay shown for status check of the data masking.
